llm_response.reason: The website exhibits several scam hallmarks: it falsely brands itself as an Acne Studios outlet using an unrelated Greek domain, all major links direct to another suspicious domain (acnestudios.co.at), and it leverages 'Outlet Sale', free shipping promises, and unclear contact/privacy information. Legitimate Acne Studios domains do not utilize 'salomons.gr' or 'acnestudios.co.at'. The site mimics the layout of legitimate brands and heavily relies on urgency and deep discounts—common features of fake shopping scams.
